name: Obed-edom
description: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy

points: David would not remove the ark to the city of David but carried it aside to the house of Obededom the Gittite, where it remained three months; and the Lord blessed Obededom and all his household because of the ark.

note.label: 2 Samuel 6: David Brings Up the Ark of God

points: When David heard the Lord had blessed the house of Obededom because of the ark, he went and brought up the ark to the city of David with gladness. When those that bore it had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

note.label: 2 Samuel 6: David Brings Up the Ark of God

points: David and the elders and captains went to bring up the ark from the house of Obededom with joy.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 15: None Ought to Carry the Ark but the Levites

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Obed-edom the Gittite
cases.charge: Keeping the ark of God in his house three months, after it had killed Uzzah
cases.preview: Uzzah had just died for putting forth his hand to the ark, and David was afraid of the Lord that day and asked how the ark should come to him.
